import csv
top="26776421-83f2-518b-9716-873fcaa13a04"
mid="0361d2c1-48db-57ae-b48b-913d1c1cef38"
def collect(ts):
    pts={}
    with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
        r=csv.reader(f)
        next(r)
        for row in r:
            if row[0]==ts:
                t=row[1]
                if t.startswith("2018-01-20") and 8<=int(t[11:13])<=18:
                    pts[t]=float(row[2])
    return pts
tp=collect(top)

mt=sum(tp.values())/len(tp)
mm=sum(mp.values())/len(mp)
print(mt,mm,mt-mm)
